copy.Information_may_be_shared_with_service_p: Information may be shared with service providers who support our operations, subject to appropriate safeguards. We retain information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described here.
copy.You_may_request_access_correction_or_del: You may request access, correction or deletion of personal information by emailing info@eliteinnovates.com. Some information may be retained where required by law.
